code: /** Returns true if the string contains Arabic Unicode characters */export const isArabic=text=>/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(text);/** Returns the CSS text direction based on content */export const getDir=text=>isArabic(text)?"rtl":"ltr";/** Returns the appropriate font-family string based on content */export const getFont=text=>isArabic(text)?"'Noto Sans Arabic', 'DM Sans', sans-serif":"'DM Sans', sans-serif";
